title: 第21章 两千多年前的古人掌握了超越现代文明的材料技术第22章 误闯天家考古队遭重创
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
演播厅里，陈振博士脸上的自信瞬间凝固，取而代之的是见了鬼难以置信。
他喃喃自语：“不可能……这怎么可能……我的计算不可能出错……”
直播间的弹幕，在经历了短暂的死寂之后，以井喷式的姿态彻底爆发了。
【我看到了什么？钻头碎了？我眼花了吗？】
【碎了！真的碎了！号称能钻穿钢板的玩意儿，连个印子都没留下就碎了？】
【这他妈是门？这是盘古开天辟地用的斧头吧！太离谱了！】
【陈博士脸都绿了，哈哈哈哈，科学的尽头是玄学，古人诚不我欺！】
【我收回之前的话，这地方太邪门了，林队你们还是撤吧，我害怕！】
攻坚失败！
而且是以最直接，最震撼的方式，宣告了现代顶级科技在这扇门前的完败。
这个结果，给所有人带来的冲击是无与伦比的。
它意味着，两千多年前的古人，掌握了完全超越现代文明的材料技术。
这个认知，让很多人都感觉自己的世界观受到了剧烈的冲击。
现场，林薇的脸色也变得无比难看。
她死死地盯着那扇连划痕都没有留下的青铜门，心中第一次涌起了无力感。
连“破壁者”都失败了，他们还有什么办法？
难道这次举国关注的考古行动，就要在这里止步了吗？
“林队，现在怎么办？”
队员老王的声音有些干涩。
林薇没有回答，她的大脑在飞速运转，思考着一切可能的方案。

爆破？
不行。
先不说能不能炸开，万一引起地宫坍塌，所有人都得埋在这里。
切割？
连钻头都碎了，用什么切割？
激光吗？
这里是地底深处，根本没有条件架设那么大功率的设备。
难道……
真的没有办法了吗？
就在所有人都陷入绝望的时候，演播厅里，一直闭目养神的金世昌金老，忽然睁开了眼睛。
“蛮力，是破不了阵的。”
他缓缓地说道，声音不大，却清晰地传到了每一个人的耳朵里。
“想要破阵，就必须找到它的‘阵眼’，也就是它的核心。”
冰冰眼睛一亮，连忙问道：“金老，那这扇门的阵眼在哪里？”
金世昌摇了摇头：“老夫也看不出来。这种上古禁断大阵的复杂程度，远超想象。不过……”
他指着屏幕上那诡异的图案中心，说道：“万变不离其宗。任何阵法，其核心必然是能量最汇聚，也是最薄弱的地方。如果非要试，不如就从那里下手。”
他的话，通过现场的通讯设备，清晰地传到了林薇的耳朵里。
林薇看向了那个图案的中心。
那是一个由无数符文交织缠绕，最终汇聚而成的一个点。
看起来，平平无奇。

用玄学的方法，去解决一个科学无法解决的问题？
林薇的内心在挣扎。
她是一个坚定的唯物主义者，从小接受的教育告诉她，要相信科学。
可是现在，科学已经走到了尽头。
“林队？”
content_en:
In the studio, the confidence on Dr. Chen Zhen's face instantly solidified, replaced by disbelief.
He murmured to himself: "It's impossible... How is this possible... My calculations can't be wrong..."
After a brief period of silence, the barrage in the live broadcast room completely erupted in a blowout style.
【What did I see? The drill bit is broken? Am I dazzled? 】
【Broken! Really broken! The thing that claims to be able to drill through steel plates shattered without even leaving a mark? 】
[What the hell is this door? This must be the ax Pangu used to create the world! That's outrageous! 】
[Dr. Chen’s face turned green, hahahaha, the end of science is metaphysics, the ancients are honest and I don’t bully them! 】
[I take back what I said before. This place is too evil. Captain Lin, you should retreat. I'm afraid! 】
The attack failed!
And in the most direct and shocking way, it announced the complete defeat of modern top technology in front of this door.
This result has an unparalleled impact on everyone.
It means that the ancients more than two thousand years ago mastered material technology that completely surpassed modern civilization.
This realization makes many people feel that their worldview has been severely impacted.
At the scene, Lin Wei's face became extremely ugly.
She stared intently at the bronze door that didn't even have a scratch, feeling powerless for the first time in her heart.
Even the "Wall Breakers" have failed, what else can they do?
Could it be that this archaeological operation that has attracted nationwide attention will stop here?
"Captain Lin, what should we do now?"
Team member Lao Wang's voice was a little dry.
Lin Wei didn't answer. Her brain was running rapidly, thinking about all possible plans.
blasting?
no.
Let’s not talk about whether it can explode. If the underground palace collapses, everyone will be buried here.
Cutting?
Even the drill bit is broken, what to use for cutting?
Laser?
This place is deep underground, and there is no condition to set up such high-power equipment.
Could it be...
Is there really no other way?
Just when everyone fell into despair, in the studio, Jin Shichang, who had been concentrating with his eyes closed, suddenly opened his eyes.
"Brute force cannot break the formation."
He said slowly, his voice was not loud, but it reached everyone's ears clearly.
"If you want to break the formation, you must find its 'eye of the formation', which is its core."
Bingbing's eyes lit up and she quickly asked: "Mr. Jin, where is the formation of this door?"
Jin Shichang shook his head: "I can't tell it either. The complexity of this ancient forbidden formation is far beyond imagination. But..."
He pointed at the center of the strange pattern on the screen and said: "Everything is different from its origin. The core of any formation must be the place where the energy is the most concentrated and the weakest. If you have to try it, it's better to start there."
His words were clearly transmitted to Lin Wei's ears through the on-site communication equipment.
Lin Wei looked at the center of the pattern.
It was a point where countless runes were intertwined and eventually converged.
It seems unremarkable.
Use metaphysical methods to solve a problem that science cannot solve?
Lin Wei was struggling in her heart.
She is a staunch materialist, and the education she received from an early age told her to believe in science.
But now, science has come to an end.
"Team Lin?"
